vAyvagniviprAnAdityamapaH paSyaMstaTEva ca । na kadAcana kurvvIta viRmUtrasya visarjjanam ॥” ityAhnikatattvam ॥ api ca । “mUtraSlezmapurIzARi yErutsfzwAni vAriRi । te pAtyante ca viRmU tre durganDe pUyapUrite ॥” iti vAmanapurARe karmmavipAko nAma 12 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aTa salilaparIkzA । pitAmahaH । “toyasyATa pravakzyAmi viDiM DarmmyaM sanAtanam । maRqalaM puzpaDUpAByAM kArayet suvicakzaRaH ॥ SarAn saMpUjayedBaktyA vERavaYca DanustaTA ॥” tatra praTamato varuRaM pUjayet । yaTA nAradaH । “ganDamAlyEH suraBiBirmaDukzIraGftAdiBiH । varuRAya prakurvvIta pUjAmAdO samAhitaH ॥” tato DarmmAvAhanAdisakaladevatApUjAhomasamantrakapratijYApatraSironiveSAntaM karmma kuryyAt । kAtyAyanaH । “SarAMstvanAyasAgrAMstu prakurvvIta viSudDaye । veRukAzWamayAScEva kzeptA ca sudfQaM kzipet ॥” pitAmahaH । “kzeptA ca kzattriyaH kAryyaH tadvfttirbrAhmaRo'TavA । akrUrahfdayaH SAntaH sopavAsastaTA SuciH ॥ izUnna prakzipedDImAn mArute vAti vA BfSam । vizame BUpradeSe ca vfkzasTARusamAkule ॥” nAradaH । “krUraM DanuH saptaSataM maDyamaM zawSataM matam । mandaM paYcaSataM proktameza jYeyo DanurvviDiH ॥” aNgulInAM saptADikaM SataM yasya DanuzaH parimARaM tat saptaSataM evaM zawSatAdikam । pitAmahaH । “maDyamena tu cApena prakzipettu Saratrayam । hastAnAYca Sate sArdDe lakzyaM kftvA vicakzaRaH ॥ tezAYca prezitAnAntu SarARAM SAstradeSanAt । maDyamastu Saro grAhyaH puruzeRa balIyasA ॥ SarARAM patanaM grAhyaM sarpaRaM parivarjjayet । sarpan sarpan Saro yAti dUrAddUrataraM yataH ॥” patanaM grAhyamiti SarapatanasTAnaparyyantaM gacCedityarTaH । tena prasaraRapakze'pi patanasTAnakaSaragrahaRam । tataSca praTamataH puruzAntareRa tatsTAne Sara AnetavyaH । nAradaH । “nadIzu nAtivegAsu taqAgezu saraHsu ca । hradezu sTiratoyezu kuryyAt puMsAM nimajjanam ॥” nAtivegAsu sTitiviroDivegaSUnyAsu । vizRuH । paNkaSEvAladuzwagrAhamatsyajalOkAdivarjjite tasya nABimAtrajale magnasyArAgadveziRaH puruzasyAnyasyorU gfhItvABimantritAmBaH praviSet । tatsamakAlaYca nAtikrUramfdunA DanuzA puruzo'paraH SaramokzaM kuryyAditi । tasya SoDyasyetyarTaH । anyaTA tasyeti vyarTaM syAt ॥ * ॥ anyapuruzasya stamBaDAraRamAha smftiH । “udake prANmuKastizWedDarmmasTURAM pragfhya ca ॥” prAqvivAkakarttfkajalABimantraRamAha pitAmahaH । “toya tvaM prARinAM prARaH sfzwerAdyantu nirmmitam । SudDeSca kAraRaM proktaM dravyARAM dehinAntaTA । atastvaM darSayAtmAnaM SuBASuBaparIkzaRe ॥” * ॥ SoDyakarttfkABimantraRamAha yAjYavalkyaH । “satyena mABirakzasva varuRetyaBiSApya kam । nABimAtrodakasTasya gfhItvorU jalaM viSet ॥” mA mAmaBiSApya SapaTaM kArayitvA kaM jalaM viSet nimajjet । toraRaYca nimajjanasamIpe same sTAne SoDyakarRapramARocCritaM kAryyam । yaTA, nAradaH । “gatvA tu tajjalasTAnaM tawe toraRamucCritam । kurvvIta karRamAtrantu BUmiBAge same SucO ॥” Saramokze viSezamAhaturnAradabfhaspatI । “SaraprakzepaRasTAnAdyuvA javasamanvitaH । gacCet paramayA SaktyA yatrAsO maDyamaH SaraH ॥ maDyamaM SaramAdAya puruzo'nyastaTAviDaH । pratyAgacCet tu vegena yataH sa puruzo gataH ॥ Agatastu SaragrAhI na paSyati yadA jale । antarjjalagataM samyak tadA SudDiM vinirddiSet ॥ anyaTA na viSudDaH syAdekANgasyApi darSanAt । sTAnAdvAnyatra gamanAdyasmin pUrvvaM niveSayet ॥” javinO viSezayati nAradaH । “paYcASato DAvakAnAM yO syAtAmaDikO jave । tO ca tatra niyoktavyO SarAnayanakarmmaRi ॥” ekANgasya darSanAditi karRAdyaBiprAyeRa । “SiromAtrantu dfSyeta na karRO nApi nAsike । apsu praveSane yasya SudDaM tamapi nirddiSet ॥” iti viSezABiDAnAt ॥ kAtyAyanaH । “nimajjyotplavate yastu dazwaScet prARinA naraH । punastatra nimajjeta daMSacihnavicAritaH ॥” jalAntargatamatsyajalOkAdinA dazwaH samutplavate yadi tadA dazwe dfzwe punarnimajjanIya ityarTaH ॥ * ॥ pitAmahaH । “gantuScApi ca karttuSca samaM gamanamajjanam । gacCettoraRamUlAttu SarasTAnaM javI naraH ॥ tasmin gate dbitIyo'pi vegAdAdAya SAyakam । gacCettoraRamUlantu yataH sa puruzo gataH ॥ Agatastu SaragrAhI na paSyati yadA jale । antarjjalagataM samyak tataH SudDiM vinirddiSet ॥” atra majjanasamakAlaM gamanABiDAnAt SaramokzasamakAlaM gamanaM SUlapARyuktamayuktam । majjanasamakAlakziptaM maDyamaM SaramAdAyetyaparamuktamapi pramARaSUnyam । tataSca trizu Sarezu muktezu eko vegavAn maDyamaSarapatanasTAnaM gatvA tamAdAya tatrEva tizWati anyastu puruzo vegavAn SaramokzasTAne toraRamUle tizWati evaM sTitayostftIyAyAM karatAlikAyAM prAqvivAkadattAyAM SoDyo nimajjati tatsamakAlameva toraRamUlasTito'pi drutataraM maDyamaSarapatanasTAnaM gacCati SaragrAhI ca tasmin prApte drutataraM toraRamUlaM prApyAntarjjalagataM yadi na paSyati tadA SudDo BavatIti varttulArTaH ॥ * ॥ tatra prayogaH । uktalakzaRajalASayanikawe taTA toraRaM viDAya uktadeSe lakzyaM kftvA toraRasamIpe saSaraM DanuH saMpUjya jalASaye varuRamAvAhya pUjayitvA tattIre DarmmAdIMSca devAn havanAntamizwvA dakziRAM kftvA SoDyasya Sirasi pratijYApatraM badDvA prAqvivAko jalamaBimantrayet । “o~ toya tvaM prARinAM prARaH sfzwerAdyantu nirmmitam । SudDeSca kAraRaM proktaM dravyARAM dehinAM taTA । atastvaM darSayAtmAnaM SuBASuBaparIkzaRe ॥” iti mantreRa ॥ SoDyastu o~ satyena mABirakzasva varuRetyanena jalamaBimantrya gfhItasTURasya SoDyanABimAtrodakAvasTitasya balIyasaH prANmuKasya puruzasya samIpaM jalamaDye gacCet । tataH Sarezu trizu muktezu maDyamaSarapatanasTAne maDyamaSaraM gfhItvA javinyekasmin puruze sTite anyasmiMSca toraRamUle sTite prAqvivAkena tAlatraye datte SoDyo gfhItasTURaprANmuKapuruzasyorU gfhItvA nimajjati । tatsamakAlameva toraRamUlasTo'pi maDyamaSarasTAnaM drutaM gacCati । tataH SaragrAhI ca tasmin prApte drutaM toraRamUlaM prApya jalAntaHsTaM yadi na
